orders.text:
AO No. 358 of 2009 Hon’ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Heard Mr. T.A. Khan, learned counsel for the appellant and 
perused the impugned judgment and award dated 11.08.2009, 
passed by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal /Additional District 
Judge / First Fast Track Court, Dehradun, in Motor Accident 
Claim Petition No. 190 of 2008. 
Admit the appeal. 
Issue notices to respondents. 
Summon the Lower Court Record. 
List after Lower Court Record is received. 
Meanwhile, as an interim measure, it is directed that if the 
appellant deposits 50% of the sum awarded by the Tribunal 
before it (MACT) within a period of one month from today, 
recovery in respect of remaining 50% shall remain stayed until 
further orders of this Court. (Stay Application No. 9349 of 2009 
stands disposed of). 
 
(P.C.P., J.)
30.10.2009
NS
